trade_signal_doctrine.entry_logic: Preemptive entry at predicted wick-rejection zone (defensive staff) with tight SL; no waiting for confirmation.
confluences: Confluence 1: SMC, Supply/Demand, and Trend Indicators. The H4 and H1 bearish trends (with EMA50/200 sloping downwards and Ichimoku cloud acting as overhead resistance) align with the mitigation of the newly formed H1 supply zone (76834.00 - 76866.00). This zone represents an unmitigated order block where institutional sell orders are clustered, preparing for a continuation of the HTF bearish trend.

Confluence 2: MSNR, FVG, and Momentum Indicators. The Malaysian SNR level at 76893.91 acts as a strong ceiling, aligning with the unmitigated H1 Fair Value Gap (FVG) between 76893.91 and 77058.42. The M15 RSI at 46.5 indicates bearish momentum control, validating that any retracement into this FVG will face immediate rejection.

Confluence 3: CRT, Candlestick Patterns, and Volatility Indicators. Under Candle Range Theory (CRT), the premium of the current M15 range lies above 76800.00. The M5 candles show clear wick rejections at 76866.01, indicating defensive staff placement. High M15 ATR (115.27) ensures sufficient volatility to tap the entry and rapidly expand downward.

Confluence 4: Quarter Theory (QT), Fibonacci Retracement, and Volume Indicators. The 77000.00 major psychological level (QT) acts as a macro barrier. The 0.5 Fibonacci retracement of the recent H1 drop (77182.00 to 76500.00) sits at 76841.00, aligning perfectly with our entry price of 76845.00. VPVR shows a low-volume node at this level, indicating price will slice through it quickly on the breakdown.

Confluence 5: BOS, Chart Patterns, and Volume Indicators. The H1 Break of Structure (BOS) below 77058.42 confirms bearish dominance. The M15 chart pattern forms a bearish continuation flag. Declining OBV and negative CMF (distribution) confirm that the bounce to 76866.01 was low-volume manipulation to grab liquidity before the next leg down.

confidence_model.dominant_bias_reason: Strong alignment of H4/H1/M15 bearish trends, H1 Break of Structure (BOS), mitigation of the 76834.00-76866.00 supply zone, and rejection at the 0.5 Fibonacci retracement level, supported by bearish momentum (RSI 46.5) and high ATR volatility.

risk_profile.note: Preemptive entry captures full HTF continuation without waiting for wick confirmation.
